data_card.measured: Pressure, flow rate and depth in the University of Sheffield facility linking a 4 m × 8.2 m floodplain to a pipe network through a manhole, for a range of flows and manhole-lid configurations.
data_card.method: Laboratory facility instrumentation described in the CoUDlabs data report (Zenodo 10683906).
data_card.uncertainty: To be taken from the data report before promotion.
known_issues: The open dataset (CoUDlabs, 2024) studies manhole-lid effects on surcharge; the case must be built from that dataset, not from the 2017 paper's figures.
data_card.exercises: Water leaving a surcharged sewer through a manhole onto a surface and spreading: the exchange flow and the head loss at the manhole.
data_card.cannot_tell: The exchange coefficient is partly a calibration choice; a match shows the coupling can be tuned to the rig, not that it transfers to other manhole geometries.

title: Rubinato manhole exchange
